metadata.title: Rajasthan Royals War Room Scouting Dossier (IPL 2027)
metadata.prepared_for: Kumar Sangakkara (Head Coach) & Giles Lindsay (Director of Strategy and Analytics)

strengths: Astonishing 183.4 Strike Rate under high pressure with +52.1 uplift vs baseline
Deadly 211.3 SR at the death (overs 16-20) when batting deep
Elite boundary percentage of 30.0% against highest-leverage bowling
Proven five-time championship captaincy and crisis leadership
vulnerabilities: Susceptible to express left-arm inswing in the first 8 balls of an innings
36.8% dot ball rate indicates feast-or-famine approach early in high-pressure chases
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Sawai Mansingh Stadium's larger square boundaries allow him to convert pull shots into maximums with pure timing; true bounce at Guwahati suits his front-foot stride.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: Rohit provides Rajasthan with an experienced match-winner who takes pressure completely off Yashasvi Jaiswal and Sanju Samson, giving RR an explosive, fear-free top order.

top10_batters_scouting.auction_tier: High-Priority Domestic Acquisition (The Next 'Vignesh Puthur' Scale Win)
strengths: Massive +69.2 Strike Rate uplift under pressure (171.8 Pressure SR vs 102.6 Baseline)
Elite 185.5 SR in death overs (16-20) across 436 pressure balls faced
Exceptionally low 29.1% dot ball rate under pressure (lowest among primary finishers)
Mastery of high back-foot punch and pull against express hit-the-deck pace
vulnerabilities: Can be contained by tight left-arm orthodox spin pitching on leg and spinning away in middle overs
Relatively small career sample compared to international stalwarts
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Perfect for Jaipur: his gap-finding agility and low dot percentage maximize runs on large outfields, and his power clears the straight boundaries comfortably.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: The exact solution to RR's long-standing death-overs puzzle. Slots in at #6 directly alongside Dhruv Jurel and Shimron Hetmyer, creating an indomitable lower order.

strengths: 182.8 Pressure Strike Rate and blistering 193.0 Death Overs SR
28.0% boundary rate under high leverage
Fearless intent against 140+ kph pace from ball one
Offers useful off-spin utility to break right-hand combinations
vulnerabilities: High dismissal rate when trying to clear deep midwicket against deceptive slower cutters
Needs tactical discipline in low-scoring, grind-out matches
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Excels on true surfaces like Guwahati and the center wicket at Jaipur; punishes spinners through the covers.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: High-upside domestic asset. Gives Kumar Sangakkara flexibility to deploy him as an Impact Player or float him ahead of Hetmyer when wickets fall in clusters.

strengths: Unbelievable +92.8 Strike Rate uplift under pressure (170.6 Pressure SR vs 77.9 Baseline)
579 pressure balls faced with 171.9 death SR and 25.9% boundary conversion
Forensic understanding of field sets, fine-leg ramp and deep-backward-point carving
Calm tactical decision-making in super-overs and last-over finishes
vulnerabilities: Age and fitness management over a long 14-game season
Struggles against high-bouncing express bouncers directed at the helmet
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: His 360-degree deflection game counters Jaipur's larger straight boundaries by relentlessly targeting fine-leg and third-man.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: Brings championship calmness. Could be utilized as an Impact Sub specialist closer to relieve pressure from Dhruv Jurel.

strengths: 165.9 Pressure SR with 185.8 Death Overs SR across 501 pressure balls
Destroys left-arm pace and leg-spin through aggressive one-handed pickups over midwicket
Generates extreme psychological intimidation on opposition captains and bowlers
World-class wicketkeeping athleticism
vulnerabilities: Can fall into wide-off-stump traps outside the tramline when over-eager
Requires high purse commitment that limits all-rounder depth
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Dominant at Sawai Mansingh Stadium where his leg-side power clears the deepest stands with ease.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: If available at the auction, Pant gives RR a left-hand powerhouse in the middle order to partner Sanju Samson, completely unbalancing opposition bowling plans.

strengths: Huge +79.1 Strike Rate uplift under pressure (166.9 Pressure SR vs 87.8 Baseline)
Outstanding 174.1 SR during Innings 2 chases when RRR >= 9.5
Unmatched sweep and scoop repertoire against fast bowlers bowling wide yorkers
Demonstrated psychological resilience in multi-wicket collapse chases
vulnerabilities: 87.8 baseline SR reflects vulnerability when required to build standard innings against disciplined spin
Prone to LBW against fast skidding deliveries directed at middle stump
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Can utilize the short square boundaries from one end at SMS Stadium with his sweep shot, neutralizing defensive bowling tactics.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: A bespoke crisis weapon. In matches where RR needs 45 runs off the last 18 balls, Ashutosh has proven he can deliver where traditional batters stall.

strengths: High-floor pressure SR with strong chase conversion
Experienced captaincy/leadership in high-leverage chases
Balances boundary intent with low panic under RRR pressure
vulnerabilities: Can go quiet if early swing traps him on a length
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Jaipur's true bounce suits his punch-through-cover game.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: Auction Official middle-order insurance who keeps RR's chase architecture calm when RRR climbs.

top10_batters_scouting.archetype: The Premier Indian Ice-Man & Finish Specialist
strengths: Over 903 pressure balls faced with 161.4 Pressure SR and 178.0 Death SR
Phenomenal composure when requiring 15+ runs in the 20th over
Compact, uncluttered swing with exceptional bat speed and bottom-hand power
Outstanding boundary-rider fielding and direct-hit run-out capability
vulnerabilities: Can occasionally be tied down by wide, dipping slower balls outside off if bowled with discipline
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Effortlessly clears Jaipur's 75m straight boundary; loves chasing under lights with dew.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: The ultimate partner for Sanju Samson and Riyan Parag. Rinku gives RR the guarantee that no chase is dead until the final ball.

strengths: Elite death-pressure strike rate and boundary frequency
Secondary seam overs give XI flexibility
Proven finisher under steep RRR
vulnerabilities: Sample can thin if used only as a pure impact bat
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Large square boundaries reward his straight hitting at SMS.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: Overseas finishing muscle that clears Auction Official IPL floors while covering #6 fragility.

strengths: Huge volume: 1,033 pressure balls faced with 177.8 Pressure SR and 208.0 Death SR
27.2% boundary rate with unmatched field manipulation behind square
Proven track record across all tournament knockout scenarios
Renders traditional field settings useless through scoop, sweep and over-extra-cover loft
vulnerabilities: High auction demand means maximum purse allocation
top10_batters_scouting.venue_fit: Universal compatibility: Jaipur's deep square fences are easily cleared by his trademark behind-square wrist whip.
top10_batters_scouting.scouting_summary: The definitive benchmark for T20 batting under pressure. If Rajasthan Royals have the purse, Suryakumar is the single most destructive asset in world cricket.

top10_bowlers_scouting.archetype: All-Time Elite Defensive Mystery Anchor & Death Choke Artist
strengths: Tournament-defining 6.47 Pressure Economy across 554 pressure balls
Astonishing 6.06 Death Overs Economy (16-20) under extreme pressure (unrivaled globally)
39.9% dot ball rate and 35 pressure wickets (strike rate: 15.8 balls per wicket)
Complete disguise on knuckle ball, carrom ball, and orthodox off-break
vulnerabilities: Rarely gives big flight to invite mistimed hits, occasionally allowing singles when defending sub-6 totals
Batting can be neutralized by high-pace body-line bouncers if used as pinch-hitter
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Sawai Mansingh Stadium is paradise for Narine: the large square boundaries make his flat, trajectory-varied bowling nearly impossible to hit for six.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: The single most restrictive bowler in the entire dataset. Solves RR's death-over leakage permanently by bowling overs 17 and 19 for under 7 runs.

strengths: 6.91 Pressure Economy across 563 pressure balls with 40 wickets (14.1 balls per wicket)
39.1% dot ball rate under pressure
Subtle variation in pace and trajectory, rarely gives boundary balls
Elite fielding and reliable lower-order batting composure
vulnerabilities: 9.51 death overs economy indicates he should not be bowled in overs 18-20
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Can bowl anywhere; highly effective at Jaipur with his flat, defensive trajectories.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: The consummate professional. Gives RR tactical flexibility to choke the middle overs and create scoreboard pressure.

strengths: 51 pressure wickets across 714 balls with a strike rate of 14.0 balls per dismissal
Revamped quicker trajectory (85-92 kph) prevents batters from stepping out
Exceptional dip and sharp turn both ways against RHB and LHB
7.67 overall pressure economy (very respectable for an attacking wrist-spinner)
vulnerabilities: 8.45 death overs economy shows he is best used as a middle-overs partnership breaker rather than 20th-over specialist
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Thrives at Sawai Mansingh Stadium where wrist spin historically dominates visiting batting lineups.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: The definitive Indian attacking spinner. Guarantees 2-3 wickets in middle overs, halting opposition momentum before Sandeep Sharma closes at the death.

top10_bowlers_scouting.archetype: The Global Gold Standard Pace Spearhead
strengths: Universal excellence: 7.49 Pressure Economy and 7.41 Death Economy across 780 balls
53 wickets at 14.7 balls per dismissal with 38.2% dot balls
Pinpoint toe-crushing yorker, dipping slower ball, and vicious skidding bouncer
Psychological supremacy: opposition teams systematically look to play him out for 20 runs
vulnerabilities: Workload management and physical maintenance throughout a congested calendar
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Universal performer. Lethal on both Jaipur's skiddy surface and Guwahati's bouncy pitch.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: The benchmark bowler against whom every candidate is measured. Having Bumrah guarantees RR can defend any total above 160.

strengths: Strong weighted pressure economy with IPL sample depth
Wicket threat vs right-hand middle orders
Comfortable bowling with men back in the circle
vulnerabilities: Left-hand power hitters can target the shorter side
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Jaipur grip amplifies his wrong'un and top-spinner.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: IPL-proven leg-spin choke option on the Auction Official board.

strengths: Highest pressure volume in dataset: 1,165 balls with 96 wickets (12.1 balls per wicket)
7.71 Pressure Economy with 37.5% dot ball rate
Lightning-quick arm action makes his googly impossible to read off the hand
Adds explosive lower-order batting hitting at #8
vulnerabilities: 8.36 death economy means he should be bowled out by over 17
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Devastating at Sawai Mansingh Stadium; opposition batters have zero room to work with against his speed.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: A proven match-winner who guarantees wickets in every high-pressure scenario. Transforms Rajasthan's bowling attack into the best in the tournament.

strengths: High wicket rate under pressure with googly variation
Can bowl powerplay and death overs
Useful lower-order batting for RR balance
vulnerabilities: Economy can spike if googly is read early
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: SMS turn and bounce suit his attacking length.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: Attacking overseas spinner who clears IPL floors and adds batting depth.

top10_bowlers_scouting.archetype: High-Value Domestic Death Seamer & Wicket Machine
top10_bowlers_scouting.rr_slot: #2 Death Pace Specialist (Overs 16 & 18) / Sandeep Sharma Partner
strengths: Exceptional wicket strike rate: 10.6 balls per wicket under pressure (30 wickets in 319 balls!)
Economy resistance: his pressure economy (9.10) is significantly BETTER than his baseline economy (10.25)
Tremendous back-of-the-hand slower ball and accurate wide yorker execution
Uncapped/emerging Indian fast bowler status protects auction purse
vulnerabilities: Economy of 9.10 under pressure is higher than elite spinners, but acceptable given his extreme wicket-taking frequency
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: His change-of-pace deliveries grip into Jaipur's clay surface, making him exceptionally difficult to pick under lights.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: The ultimate domestic value discovery. Solves RR's domestic pace depth at minimal purse impact, freeing capital for marquee batters.

top10_bowlers_scouting.archetype: Deceptive Mystery Spinner with Stumps-Targeting Trajectory
strengths: 66 pressure wickets across 877 balls (13.3 balls per dismissal)
39.8% dot ball rate and 8.37 pressure economy
Attacks the stumps directly (high bowled and LBW dismissal percentage)
Carrom ball and top-spinner are difficult to gauge under night floodlights
vulnerabilities: Vulnerable if wet ball impairs grip at death overs
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Jaipur's red-soil track gives his carrom ball extra skid and bounce.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: A proven Indian mystery weapon. Guarantees RR has an attacking wicket-taker who can dismantle opposition middle orders in pressure chases.

strengths: Unique release angle creates late swing into the blockhole
Strong death-pressure wicket threat
Complements RR's Sandeep Sharma end
vulnerabilities: Workload management and injury history need monitoring
top10_bowlers_scouting.venue_fit: Straight boundaries at SMS reward his yorker-length attack.
top10_bowlers_scouting.scouting_summary: Death-overs pace option with enough IPL sample to sit on Auction Official.
